description: AG-1 Audit Intelligence Graph for GII GeM ERP. Catalogs the audit action catalog (events), source modules, data mutation boundaries, actor roles, approval flows, compliance controls, critical actions, audit stores and trust boundaries. Built read-only from the audit trail implementation; contains no live business data.

graphReferences.role: Declares audit_log, allocation_audit and voucher_proposal_audit table structures
Approval and closure stages (approval submit/approve, order closure) are audit-observable lifecycle events
Voucher posting and reversal actions are the highest-severity accounting audit events
Renderer IPC channels that originate audit entries (audit:context, document view/download)
User-facing modules and business rules referenced by audit modules
Metadata and permissions context for actor roles and trust boundaries

auditStores.purpose: Primary generic audit trail for every audited action across modules.
auditStores.integrityMechanism: SHA-256 event_hash over serialized event body (created_at included)

auditStores.purpose: Receipt/payment/advance allocation change trail. Every write is mirrored to audit_log as 'allocation <action>'.
auditStores.integrityMechanism: Mirror write into audit_log preserves the generic trail

auditStores.purpose: Bank reconciliation voucher proposal lifecycle (generate → edit → approve/reject → draft voucher → voucher posted).
auditStores.integrityMechanism: Terminal events are additionally mirrored into audit_log (voucher_proposal_posted)

complianceControls.name: Audit event hash integrity
complianceControls.mechanism: SHA-256 event_hash computed over serialized event body including created_at at insert time

complianceControls.name: Audit log protected write policy
complianceControls.mechanism: audit_log placed in accounting read-only write-policy set; generic CRUD cannot write directly

complianceControls.name: Health center audit log check
complianceControls.mechanism: audit_log table presence verified; zero-row trail raises warning before production use

complianceControls.name: Critical action audit coverage gate
complianceControls.mechanism: verify-controls asserts critical actions (permission_denied, bulk import, rollback import, voucher reversal) are present in audit_log

complianceControls.name: Financial statement report audit evidence
complianceControls.mechanism: FSR verifiers assert inventory GL postings, year close and account mapping audit evidence exists

complianceControls.name: Audit store reset protection
complianceControls.mechanism: audit_log, voucher_proposal_audit and allocation_audit are excluded from operational reset wipe list

complianceControls.name: Delete-safety enforcement
complianceControls.mechanism: hard_delete flows through assertDeleteSafe with old_value capture; sensitive tables blocked

trustBoundaries.note: Renderer can write arbitrary audit entries by design; treat as a controlled trust boundary.
Audited with null user_id in some paths — unattributed actor coverage gap.
Proposal lifecycle stored separately; terminal events mirrored into audit_log.
Allocation trail always mirrored into the generic audit_log.

knownGaps.gap: Several audit paths record null user_id (document view/download; some crudHelpers deletes), weakening actor resolution.
voucher_proposal_audit records are not mirrored into audit_log except terminal posting events; intermediate proposal edits are only visible in the proposal store.
The generic audit:context IPC channel allows renderer-originated audit writes; acceptable by design but should be reviewed for spoofing risk.
Audit graph is descriptive; no runtime consumer yet maps live audit_log rows to graph event IDs.

validationRules: All event IDs must be unique.
Every critical event must also appear in criticalActions.
Every event must reference a module present in modules.
Every event action must map to a documented severity.
All mutations must reference a known table and classify mutation severity.
All approval stages must reference known audit actions.
The graph must not contain live business data (no real record ids, user ids, or transaction values).
All sourceDocuments paths must resolve to existing files.
metadata counts must match the arrays they describe.
statistics counts must match the eventCatalog severity distribution.
The graph must remain read-only; regeneration is the only permitted mutation path.
AG-1 must be registered in repository/graph-registry.json as Active.

risk.description: Audit trail is implemented with tamper-evident hashing and write-policy protection, but actor attribution is incomplete in a few paths and the renderer audit write channel is a controlled trust boundary.

futureExtensions: Runtime mapping of live audit_log rows to AG-1 event IDs for the Health Center and Help Assistant.
Anomaly detection over audit events (e.g., reversal bursts, repeated failed logins, after-hours postings).
Cross-graph audit lineage: event → module → screen (RG-1) → table (DG-1) → workflow stage (WG-1).
Tamper-evident audit chain with previous-hash linkage for stronger compliance evidence.
Attribution hardening for unattributed actor paths (document view/download and generic deletes).
Proposal audit mirroring so voucher_proposal_audit intermediate events also appear in audit_log.
